title: Coordinate query probability
statement: Let a randomized decision tree have a finite alphabet, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on the alphabet, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The probability that the tree queries coordinate $i$ is the expected probability of querying $i$ on an input whose $n$ coordinates are sampled independently from $\pi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability distribution on the alphabet.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definitions of the product input distribution or the probability of querying a coordinate on a fixed input.
